wrapped.source: native AWS CLI SNS/SQS authorization-failure probe

primary_references.documented: Endpoint-policy authorization failures are client-side errors; SNS does not retry client-side failed delivery and redirects to subscription DLQ when configured. Failed deliveries do not change subscription status.

SQS and Lambda AWS-managed endpoints use the service-defined retry policy for server-side errors: 100,015 attempts over 23 days. This probe does not exercise server-side failures or validate that duration.

limitations: Receive windows are bounded and do not establish permanent absence or indefinite no-retry.
Underlying SNS-to-SQS request/error is not exposed by these control-plane APIs; authorization-failure attribution uses the exact scoped explicit Deny, DLQ observation and repaired positive control.
No retry-duration or server-side retry behavior is experimentally tested.
CLI calls use one attempt; request_count counts CLI API invocations, not hidden SNS delivery attempts. No debug headers are collected.
